opinion.headline: Expressed universe
opinion.hook: Matter is understood as a varying form of energy, essential for inertness.
opinion.summary: The static principle binds subtle energies into tangible forms and lines. This static influence of Prakriti brings abstract concepts into the initial stage of matter. The sentient principle's influence is effulgent and expressive, expanding subtly. The perceived universe is the collectivity of objects bound by forms and symbolizations.
